messages:
maria: heads up — after yesterday's deprec banner rollout i’m seeing admin dashboard v1 traffic drop ~30% vs expected. looks real, not just sampling. anyone else noticing telemetry mismatch? :eyes:
ben: seeing the same. quota engine reports unchanged usage, but per-version counts in console went down.
josh: quick guess: proxy might be stripping the old version header during the banner cookie flow. we switched the banner to inject a transient cookie for opt-in, maybe it clobbers headers.
irene: logs confirm a spike in requests with no X-Client-Version header around the rollout window. many tokens map to routes that rely on that header for version attribution.
ben: confirmed. sample from logs: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Client-Version: v1" https://api.redwood.dev/generate` -> but upstream shows header missing after envoy filter.
ben: looks like our envoy lua filter sequence gets reorderd when the banner cookie plugin runs, causing header to be dropped for cookies > 4096 bytes.
maria: ouch. that explains console counts but why doesn't quota accounting show the drop?
josh: we compute quota usage upstream in the router before the envoy filter chain that mutates headers. quota sees raw token+route; console uses the post-filtered X-Client-Version tag to attribute to v1/v2 buckets.
irene: so two separate signals diverged — quota (token-based) and console telemetry (header-based). need to reconcile backfill and fix attribution.
maria: immediate mitigations: (1) hotfix envoy filter order to preserve X-Client-Version, (2) run a backfill job to recompute per-version metrics from token->route mapping for the window, (3) update dashboard copy to mention transient attribution issues.
ben: i'll own the envoy fix. patch ready, will canary to dedicated next 15m. :hammer_and_wrench:
josh: i'll write a downstream backfill query against logs -> timeseries. propose a smoothing window and annotate dashboard for the affected buckets.
irene: for backfill: our mapping is token -> tenant -> preferred route -> pinned version. i'll add that mapping export to the job; we can recompute counts and emit a synthetic metric `platform.v1_attrib_backfill`.
maria: console UX: add a small banner on admin panels: "Version attribution may be incomplete for 2026-04-18 03:20-04:10 UTC due to rollout; metrics are currently being reconciled." short and actionable.
josh: also recommend setting an automated guard: if per-version count change > 10% within 10m of a rollout, abort banner rollout or pause canary and notify #eng-oncall.
irene: agree. add a telemetry check that compares quota-derived counts to header-derived counts and flags > 15% delta as PAGE.
ben: deploying envoy reorder now. will update here once canary passes.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for envoy-filter-order fix (deploy/eng-platform) — build 2026.04.18-5.
maria: thanks all. once backfill runs, let's sync on a postmortem doc and decide whether to auto-translate quota counts into console until header attribution is stable.
ben: canary passed, rolling to 50% now. no regressions so far.
josh: kicked off backfill job, ETA 45m. i'll post results to this thread when done. :white_check_mark:
